sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मज्ञौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।निर्बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः प्रजहर्ष ननाद च ।। ६.४५.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu dharmajñau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।nirbibheda śitairbāṇaiḥ prajaharṣa nanāda ca ।। 6.45.13 ।।।।

translations.english: Indrajith having spoken to the righteous brothers Rama and Lakshmana in that way, began to pain them with arrows and stood rejoiced roaring aloud.
